name: Wildflower Statement Necklace
materials: Rough and carved citrine, smoky quartz, amethyst, peridot, pearls, pink crazy lace, orange fire agate, Czech glass floral beads and a handmade lampwork bead; gold-filled 14/20 bead accents and a gold plated clasp
description:
A colorful, one-of-a-kind statement necklace with a little bit of everything: rough and carved citrine, smoky quartz, amethyst, peridot, pearls, pink crazy lace, and orange fire agate. Czech glass floral beads and a handmade lampwork bead add playful detail. Finished with gold-filled bead accents and a gold plated clasp.

Each stone and glass bead has its own shape and character, giving this necklace its collected, artful feel.

Can be worn with the clasp in the back. The removable charm is sold separately.
